prompt:
Goal: Create a premium vertical 3:4 retro-futurist editorial poster titled SYNTH, featuring a synthetic human woman as the central subject.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, pure black textured canvas background with subtle fabric grain, high-contrast cyberpunk editorial print look, no border, full-bleed composition.

Main subject: Extreme close-up side profile of a futuristic woman looking upward toward the upper right. She has a smooth human face illuminated in deep cyan-blue with fiery orange rim light along the jaw, lips, nose, visor, and neck. Her silver-blue hair is pulled back tightly behind the ear. She wears a glossy black futuristic visor or helmet band covering her eyes, with one continuous glowing orange light arc running horizontally across the visor and curving upward at both ends. The face should feel realistic, sculptural, calm, and powerful, like a human-AI hybrid.

Layout: Place the woman large in the center, cropped at the lower chest and extending from lower left to upper right. Her head overlaps background diagrams. The giant headline SYNTH spans the entire bottom third in huge condensed block capitals, white halftone texture, partially behind and around the neck and shoulders, with thin outlined internal letter details.

Graphic elements: Include exactly 7 white technical wireframe/diagram elements around the portrait: 1 rectangular text panel in the upper left containing a small wireframe human head icon; 1 horizontal overlapping wave-loop diagram in the upper right; 1 tilted concentric oval orbit diagram near the upper right; 1 large distorted grid field behind the upper-left hair; 1 small wireframe cube at lower left; 1 rectangular grid panel to the right of the nose; 1 large warped perspective grid panel behind the lower-right neck and shoulder.

Text content: Include exactly 2 small editorial text boxes. Upper-left box text, all caps, thin white type: “SHE SEES THE WORLD IN WAVES / DATA FLOWS THROUGH HER VEINS / FEELINGS? JUST ANOTHER ALGORITHM // HER MIND IS ELECTRIC / HER SILENCE -- LOUDER THAN SOUND / BYTE ISN'T A GLITCH. SHE'S EVOLUTION”. Lower-left box text, all caps: “SHE WAS BORN FROM CODE / BUT DREAMS LIKE A HUMAN / A SYNTHETIC SOUL IN A SKIN”. The lower-left box also contains exactly 3 small icons above the text: a globe wireframe, an atom symbol, and a small hourglass-like waveform object.

Visual style: Retro-futurist 1980s science magazine cover meets luxury cyberpunk poster, crisp white technical line art, cyan and orange neon lighting, subtle halftone print texture, moody black negative space, sharp editorial typography, realistic face rendering with painterly grain.

Constraints: Keep the background black, avoid extra characters, avoid additional text beyond the specified copy and headline, maintain a premium poster composition, and preserve the exact count of 7 diagram elements, 2 text boxes, and 3 lower-box icons.
